zh.title: 波羅的海航空債券持有人通過3.8億歐元債券新條款
zh.summary: 波羅的海航空債券持有人批准修訂條款；8月與11月債券利息轉入本金
body: 據 AeroTime 報導，波羅的海航空（airBaltic）於2026年8月17日宣布，債券持有人已投票通過修改該公司2029年到期、總額3.8億歐元且利率為14.5%的未償還債券條款。相關特別決議源自該公司於2026年7月28日發出的股東大會補充通知。依據通過之決議，原定於2026年8月14日與11月14日支付的債券利息將不予派發，改為直接計入債券本金。
此外，債券持有人同意暫時豁免最低流動資金要求至2026年11月14日，並放寬部分債券條款與未來的會議出席門檻。波羅的海航空目前正尋求2.25億歐元的臨時融資與1億歐元的新股權以進行資本重組；根據該公司於2026年8月11日提出的企業重組計畫，其將收縮位於里加（RIX）主樞紐的營運，並縮減機隊與機隊濕租（ACMI）業務規模。

en.title: airBaltic Bondholders Approve New Terms for 380 Million Euro Bond Issue
en.summary: airBaltic bondholders approved revised bond terms, deferring August and November interest payments into principal.
body: AeroTime reported that airBaltic announced on August 17, 2026, that its bondholders have approved amendments to the terms of the airline’s outstanding €380 million 14.5%-interest bonds due in 2029. The resolutions were previously set out in a supplemental meeting notice issued on July 28, 2026. Under the approved terms, interest payments scheduled for August 14 and November 14, 2026, will be added to the bond principal instead of being paid out.

Bondholders also approved a temporary waiver of the minimum liquidity requirement through November 14, 2026, and relaxed several bond conditions. Concurrently, airBaltic is seeking €225 million in interim financing and €100 million in new equity. Following an August 11, 2026 reorganization plan, the carrier intends to retrench at its main Riga (RIX (RIX)) hub while downsizing both its fleet and ACMI wet-leasing operations.
